evaluation_policy: All quality-passing frames train. Periodic metrics are training diagnostics, not validation.
schedule_note: Two GPUs per hand, one frame per rank and mean gradients. 60,000 optimizer steps = 120,000 frame updates. Density, pruning, checkpoint, preview and evaluation intervals preserve the single-GPU frame-update schedule; learning rates are unchanged. This preserves the frame budget, not numerical equivalence to 120,000 single-GPU optimizer steps. Fresh SAM3.1 initialization only; GPU allocation and multi-GPU density-growth smoke test required before formal launch.
mask_policy: SAM 3.1 target; ignore unsupported glove cuff pixels in loss, never hard-clip render to MANO.
